source_text: Unlike forced circumcision, these are embedded in routine medical protocols with sterile techniques and anesthesia, though they raise ethical concerns regarding proxy decision-making for irreversible alterations to healthy tissue, with some legal analyses asserting that fundamental rights to bodily integrity supersede parental discretion absent immediate medical necessity.
